title.narrative: Action Aid Zambia : CSO Support Phase II (2024-2028)
Action Aid Zambia: CSO Support Phase II (2024-2028)

description.narrative:
Overall goal: To increase citizen awareness and demand for human rights in Zambia.
Specific Objectives:
Objective 1: To enhance Civic Participation, Accountability, and Inclusive Democracy by the year 2028.
Objective 2: To advocate for protection of women's rights and young people in the extractive industry, by promoting effective and inclusive citizen participation in natural resource governance and climate justice by the year 2028.
Objective 3: To advocate for Sexual Reproductive Health Rights (SRHR) for adolescents, women, and marginalized people by the year 2028.
Objective 4: To build institutional capacity for AAZ and Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), fostering effective coordination for joint initiatives and increased collective impact by the year 2028.

Strengthening Civil Society Effectiveness in Promoting Good Governance and Increasing Citizen's Awareness and Demand for Human Rights in Zambia, with the overall goal to increase citizen awareness and demand for human rights in Zambia.

Stärka det civila samhällets effektivitet för att främja god samhällsstryning och öka medborgarnas medvetenhet och efterfrågan på mänskliga rättigheter i Zambia, med det övergripande målet att öka medborgarnas medvetenhet och efterfrågan på mänskliga rättigheter i Zambia.
